headword: {遠隔授業|えんかくじゅぎょう}

definitions.gloss: remote classes; online education; distance learning
definitions.explanation: classes conducted over the internet where students participate from home or other locations

examples.japanese: {遠隔授業|えんかくじゅぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
⟦コロナ→コロナ：28801_korona⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{遠隔授業|えんかくじゅぎょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Remote classes increased due to COVID.

examples.japanese: {遠隔授業|えんかくじゅぎょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦オン→オン：29843_on⟧にしてください。
examples.english: Please turn your camera on during remote classes.

notes:
{遠隔授業|えんかくじゅぎょう} is the official, somewhat formal term used by schools and education authorities; students and teachers usually say ⟦オンライン→オンライン：05278_onrain⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧ or リモート⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧. It became widespread in 2020, during the COVID-19 pandemic.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{対面授業|たいめんじゅぎょう}→対面授業：17035_taimenjugyou⟧: in-person classes — the opposite
- ⟦ハイブリッド→ハイブリッド：11391_haiburiddo⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧: hybrid classes, with some students in the room and others online

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遠隔授業|えんかくじゅぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to take remote classes
- {遠隔授業|えんかくじゅぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to hold remote classes
- {遠隔授業|えんかくじゅぎょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{替|か}える→切り替える：04239_kirikaeru⟧: to switch to remote classes
